            ELSE '15+'
        END AS volume_band
    FROM december_cases c

),
ranked_matches AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

                  + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id
        ) AS match_rank
    FROM case_inputs c
    JOIN case_worksite cw
      ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw

WITH case_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.homefirm,
        c.headct,
        CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
        CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
        LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        ci.*,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) AS emcv
    FROM case_inputs ci
),
banded AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN emcv = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END AS volume_band
    FROM monthly
),
governed AS (
    SELECT
        b.filekey,
        b.homefirm,
        b.headct,
        b.start_month,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
```sql
        ) AS rn
```

        left(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        c.headct,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        pw.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'level' AS wage_level,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = c.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y'))
    WHERE c.filekey = 'I-200-23355-583990'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        ci.headct,
        row_number() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                (
                    CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                  + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) DESC,
                r.rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM case_info ci
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = ci.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR
          (ci.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level = ci.wage_level))
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR
          (ci.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent = ci.h1b_dependent))
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = ci.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = ci.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = ci.monthly_volume_band)
),
governing AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    governing.rule_id,
    round(
        coalesce(governing.base_hours, 3.50)
        + coalesce(governing.position_hours, 0.50) * ci.headct,
        2
    ) AS hours
FROM case_info ci
LEFT JOIN governing ON TRUE;

        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level

     AND mv.start_month = strftime(c.start_date, '%Y-%m')

),
matching_rules AS (

    FROM case_attributes ca

      * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')

        END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
      * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')

        END AS apw,

Using the most-specific matching review rule (breaking ties by lowest `rule_id`), with monthly volume based on cases received by the employer in that month, the averages are **5.68 hours for ‘Yes’** and **3.93 hours for ‘No’**. These averages include cases with a matching rule; cases without a match are excluded.

```sql
WITH monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        date_trunc('month', try_strptime(recvday, '%Y/%m/%d')) AS recv_month,
        COUNT(*) AS case_count
    FROM cases
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', try_strptime(recvday, '%Y/%m/%d'))
),
jan_cases AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM cases c
    WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
      AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
        c.headct,
        c.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
        SUBSTR(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM jan_cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = c.homefirm
     AND mv.recv_month = date_trunc('month', try_strptime(c.recvday, '%Y/%m/%d'))
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT
        ca.filekey,
        ca.h1b_dependent,
        ca.headct,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN rs.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN rs.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN rs.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN rs.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN rs.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN rs.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM case_attributes ca
    JOIN review_schedule rs
      ON (rs.visa_class = '*' OR rs.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
     AND (rs.wage_level = '*' OR rs.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
     AND (rs.h1b_dependent = '*' OR rs.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
     AND (rs.soc_major_group = '*' OR rs.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
     AND (rs.worksite_state = '*' OR rs.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
     AND (rs.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR rs.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
),
chosen_rule AS (
    SELECT filekey, h1b_dependent, headct, base_hours, position_hours
    FROM matched_rules
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY filekey
        ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
    ) = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(base_hours + position_hours * headct)
          FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
    ROUND(AVG(base_hours + position_hours * headct)
          FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM chosen_rule;
```

```sql
WITH parsed_cases AS (
    SELECT
        c.fileKey,
        c.homeFirm,
        c.headCt,
        strftime(strptime(c.beginDay, '%d/%m/%Y'), '%Y-%m') AS start_month,
        CAST(c.visaCls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
        CAST(c.h1bDep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
        substr(c.socCd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsState AS worksite_state,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw
        ON cw.dockKey = c.fileKey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw
        ON pw.trackNo = cw.wageTrack
),
monthly_volumes AS (
    SELECT homeFirm, start_month, count(*) AS monthly_volume
    FROM parsed_cases
    GROUP BY homeFirm, start_month
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        pc.*,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.monthly_volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.monthly_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM parsed_cases pc
    JOIN monthly_volumes mv USING (homeFirm, start_month)
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        ca.fileKey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        ((r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*')::INTEGER
         + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*')::INTEGER
         + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*')::INTEGER
         + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*')::INTEGER
         + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*')::INTEGER
         + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*')::INTEGER
        ) AS specificity
    FROM case_attributes ca
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY fileKey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM candidates
),
governing_rules AS (
    SELECT fileKey, base_hours, position_hours
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rn = 1
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        ca.homeFirm,
        ca.start_month,
        coalesce(gr.base_hours, 3.50)
            + coalesce(gr.position_hours, 0.50) * ca.headCt AS review_hours
    FROM case_attributes ca
    LEFT JOIN governing_rules gr ON gr.fileKey = ca.fileKey
)
SELECT
    start_month AS month,
    round(sum(review_hours), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM case_hours
WHERE homeFirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month;
```

WITH parsed_cases AS (
```sql
    SELECT c.*,
           try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS start_date
    FROM cases c
),
monthly_volumes AS (
    SELECT homefirm,
           date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE AS start_month,
           count(*) AS emcv
    FROM parsed_cases
    WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE
),
jan_cases AS (
    SELECT p.*,
           v.emcv,
           CASE
               WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
               WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
               WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
               WHEN v.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
           END AS monthly_volume_band,
           cw.wsstate,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM parsed_cases p
    JOIN monthly_volumes v
      ON v.homefirm = p.homefirm
     AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', p.start_date)::DATE
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = p.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND p.start_date < DATE '2024-02-01'
),
matched AS (
    SELECT j.filekey,
           j.h1bdep,
           j.headct,
           r.rule_id,
           r.base_hours,
           r.position_hours,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY j.filekey
               ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.rule_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                        ((r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                         + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                         + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                         + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                         + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                         + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER) DESC,
                        r.rule_id ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM jan_cases j
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = j.visacls::VARCHAR)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR
          (j.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level = j.wage_level))
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR
          (j.h1bdep IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent = j.h1bdep::VARCHAR))
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = left(j.soccd, 2))
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = j.wsstate)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR
          r.monthly_volume_band = j.monthly_volume_band)
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT h1bdep,
           CASE
               WHEN rule_id IS NULL THEN 3.50 + 0.50 * headct
               ELSE base_hours + position_hours * headct
           END AS crh
    FROM matched
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT round(avg(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes_cases,
       round(avg(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no_cases
FROM case_hours;
```

```sql
WITH case_volume AS (

    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.homefirm,
                   date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE
    ) AS emcv
  FROM cases c
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
case_bands AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      WHEN emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
    END AS volume_band
  FROM case_volume
),
matched_rules AS (
  SELECT
    cvb.*,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM case_bands cvb
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)

   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
),
governing AS (
  SELECT *,
    COALESCE(base_hours, 3.50)
      + COALESCE(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS crh
  FROM matched_rules
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY filekey
    ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
  ) = 1
)
SELECT
  strftime(start_month, '%Y-%m') AS start_month,
  ROUND(SUM(crh), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM governing
WHERE homefirm = 'Microsoft Corporation'
GROUP BY start_month
ORDER BY start_month ASC;
```

```sql
WITH parsed_cases AS (
    SELECT c.*, try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') AS start_date
    FROM cases c
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date) AS start_month, count(*) AS case_volume
    FROM parsed_cases
    WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)
),
jan_cases AS (
    SELECT p.*, mv.case_volume,
           CASE WHEN mv.case_volume = 1 THEN '1'
                WHEN mv.case_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
                WHEN mv.case_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
                ELSE '15+' END AS volume_band
    FROM parsed_cases p
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = p.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', p.start_date)
    WHERE p.start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND p.start_date < DATE '2024-02-01'
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT j.filekey, j.h1bdep, j.headct, j.visacls, j.soccd, j.volume_band,
           cw.wsstate,
           json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM jan_cases j
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = j.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
matched_rules AS (
    SELECT a.filekey, r.rule_id, r.base_hours, r.position_hours,
           (
             CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           ) AS specificity,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY a.filekey
               ORDER BY
                   (
                     CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                   ) DESC,
                   r.rule_id
           ) AS rn
    FROM case_attributes a
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = CAST(a.visacls AS VARCHAR))
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = a.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = CAST(a.h1bdep AS VARCHAR))
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = substring(a.soccd, 1, 2))
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = a.wsstate)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = a.volume_band)
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT a.h1bdep,
           coalesce(r.base_hours, 3.50)
             + coalesce(r.position_hours, 0.50) * a.headct AS review_hours
    FROM case_attributes a
    LEFT JOIN matched_rules r
      ON r.filekey = a.filekey
     AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT round(avg(review_hours) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_review_hours_yes,
       round(avg(review_hours) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_review_hours_no
FROM case_hours;
```

```sql
WITH rv AS (
    SELECT cvb.filekey, cvb.homefirm, cvb.start_month, cvb.headct, cvb.visa_class, cvb.wage_level,
           cvb.h1b_dependent, cvb.soc_major_group, cvb.worksite_state, cvb.emcv, cvb.volume_band,
           r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
           COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
           COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours,
           COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) * cvb.headct AS crh
    FROM (
        SELECT cv.*,
               CASE WHEN cv.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
                    WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
                    WHEN cv.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
                    WHEN cv.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+' END AS volume_band
        FROM (
            SELECT cb.*, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY cb.homefirm, cb.start_month) AS emcv
            FROM (
                SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.headct,
                       CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
                       CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
                       LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
                       date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
                       cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
                       pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
                FROM main.cases c
                LEFT JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
                LEFT JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
            ) cb
        ) cv
    ) cvb
    LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = cvb.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cvb.filekey
        ORDER BY (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                 r.rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes') / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_crh_dependent_yes,
    ROUND(SUM(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No') / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_crh_dependent_no
FROM rv
WHERE start_month = DATE '2024-01-01';
```

```sql
      AND try_strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') <  TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'

    SELECT homefirm
    FROM december_cases
    GROUP BY homefirm
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) >= 5
),

    SELECT

        try_cast(

                p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'from',

            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) * CASE p.wage_details->'offered_wage'->>'unit'
              WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
              WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
              WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
              ELSE 1
          END
        /
        (
            try_cast(
                regexp_replace(
                    p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'value',

                ) AS DOUBLE
            ) * CASE p.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'unit'
                  WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                  WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                  WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                  ELSE 1
```

```sql
WITH cases_monthly AS (
    SELECT
        filekey,
        homefirm,
        h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
        visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
        substr(soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS start_date,
        headct
    FROM cases
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE AS start_month,
        count(*) AS case_count
    FROM cases_monthly
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE
),
case_attributes AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM cases_monthly c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = c.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', c.start_date)::DATE
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        ca.filekey,
        rs.rule_id,
        rs.base_hours,
        rs.position_hours,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (rs.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND rs.visa_class <> '*')::INTEGER
                  + (rs.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND rs.wage_level <> '*')::INTEGER
                  + (rs.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND rs.h1b_dependent <> '*')::INTEGER
                  + (rs.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND rs.soc_major_group <> '*')::INTEGER
                  + (rs.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND rs.worksite_state <> '*')::INTEGER
                  + (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND rs.monthly_volume_band <> '*')::INTEGER
                ) DESC,
                rs.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rule_rank
    FROM case_attributes ca
    JOIN review_schedule rs
      ON (rs.visa_class IS NULL OR rs.visa_class = '*' OR rs.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
     AND (rs.wage_level IS NULL OR rs.wage_level = '*' OR
          (ca.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND rs.wage_level = ca.wage_level))
     AND (rs.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR rs.h1b_dependent = '*' OR
          (ca.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND rs.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent))
     AND (rs.soc_major_group IS NULL OR rs.soc_major_group = '*' OR rs.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
     AND (rs.worksite_state IS NULL OR rs.worksite_state = '*' OR rs.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
     AND (rs.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR rs.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR
          rs.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        ca.h1b_dependent,
        ca.start_date,
        coalesce(mr.base_hours, 3.50)
          + coalesce(mr.position_hours, 0.50) * ca.headct AS review_hours
    FROM case_attributes ca
    LEFT JOIN matching_rules mr
      ON mr.filekey = ca.filekey
     AND mr.rule_rank = 1
)
SELECT

    round(avg(review_hours) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_review_hours_no
FROM case_hours
WHERE start_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND start_date < DATE '2024-02-01';
```

```sql
WITH cb AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
    c.homefirm,
    c.headct,
    CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
    CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) AS h1b_dependent,
    LEFT(c.soccd, 2) AS soc_major_group,
    date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level
  FROM cases c
  LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
cv AS (
  SELECT
    cb.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY homefirm, start_month) AS emcv
  FROM cb
),
cvb AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      WHEN emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
    END AS volume_band
  FROM cv
),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    cvb.filekey,
    cvb.h1b_dependent,
    cvb.headct,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    (
      CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL AND r.visa_class <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL AND r.wage_level <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL AND r.h1b_dependent <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL AND r.soc_major_group <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL AND r.worksite_state <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM cvb
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = cvb.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
  WHERE cvb.start_month = DATE '2024-01-01'
),
governing AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY filekey
      ORDER BY specificity DESC NULLS LAST, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM matched
),
per_case AS (
  SELECT
    h1b_dependent,
    COALESCE(base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS crh
  FROM governing
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM per_case;
```

      + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL AND r.monthly_volume_band <> '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS specificity
  FROM cvb
  LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = '*' OR r.visa_class = cvb.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = '*' OR r.wage_level = cvb.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = '*' OR r.h1b_dependent = cvb.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = '*' OR r.soc_major_group = cvb.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = '*' OR r.worksite_state = cvb.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = '*' OR r.monthly_volume_band = cvb.volume_band)
  WHERE cvb.start_month = DATE '2024-01-01'
),
governing AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY filekey
      ORDER BY specificity DESC NULLS LAST, rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM matched
),
per_case AS (
  SELECT
    h1b_dependent,
    COALESCE(base_hours, 3.50) + COALESCE(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS crh
  FROM governing
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(crh) FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM per_case;

```sql
WITH wa AS (

           (b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw AS whr,
           100 * (b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw AS wdr,
           100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS headroom_points,
           CASE b.wage_level
               WHEN 'I' THEN 25
               WHEN 'II' THEN 50
               WHEN 'III' THEN 75
               WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
               ELSE 50
           END AS level_points,
           0.7 * (
               100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40
           ) + 0.3 * (
               CASE b.wage_level
                   WHEN 'I' THEN 25
                   WHEN 'II' THEN 50
                   WHEN 'III' THEN 75
                   WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
                   ELSE 50
               END
           ) AS cwas
    FROM (
        SELECT c.filekey,
               c.homefirm,
               c.homezip,
               c.soccd,
               c.headct,
               c.statustag,
               CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
               strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS begin_date,
               date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
               cw.wsstate,
               e.employer_contact_info->>'$.naics_code' AS naics_code,
               pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level,
               CAST(
                   replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.from', '$', ''), ',', '')
                   AS DOUBLE
               ) * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.unit'
                       WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                       WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                       WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                       WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
                   END AS aow,
               CAST(
                   replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '')
                   AS DOUBLE
               ) * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.unit'
                       WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                       WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                       WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                       WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
                   END AS apw
        FROM main.cases c
        JOIN main.case_worksite cw
          ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
        JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw
          ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
        LEFT JOIN main.employer e
          ON e.corphandle = c.homefirm
         AND e.zipref = c.homezip
    ) b
),
employer_scores AS (
    SELECT homefirm,
           SUM(cwas * headct) / CAST(SUM(headct) AS DOUBLE) AS ewas,
           COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) AS case_count
    FROM wa
    WHERE start_month = DATE '2023-12-01'
    GROUP BY homefirm
)
SELECT homefirm,
       ROUND(ewas, 2) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
```

The total Return Handling Charge is **1796.07**, summing the charges from rules matching each January return. The query uses `RevDate` to identify January 2025 returns and calculates each charge as `flat_charge + unit_value × charge_pct / 100`.

```sql
WITH january_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        r.return_details -> 'reasoning' ->> 'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        q.assessment_summary -> 'condition' ->> 'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        p.unit_value,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    LEFT JOIN products AS p
        ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment AS q
        ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00032'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-02-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(
        SUM(rule.flat_charge + jr.unit_value * rule.charge_pct / 100.0),
        0
    ),
    2
) AS total_rhc
FROM january_returns AS jr
JOIN return_charge_rules AS rule
    ON (rule.customer_segment IS NULL OR rule.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rule.customer_segment = jr.seg_category)
   AND (rule.return_channel IS NULL OR rule.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rule.return_channel = jr.return_channel)
   AND (rule.item_category IS NULL OR rule.item_category = 'ANY' OR rule.item_category = jr.itemcategory)

   AND (rule.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rule.min_monthly_returns <= jr.monthly_returns)
   AND (rule.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rule.max_monthly_returns >= jr.monthly_returns);
```

```sql
WITH wa AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         (b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw AS whr,
         100 * (b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw AS wdr,
         100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40 AS headroom_points,
         CASE b.wage_level
           WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
           ELSE 50
         END AS level_points,
         0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((b.aow - b.apw) / b.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
           + 0.3 * (
             CASE b.wage_level
               WHEN 'I' THEN 25 WHEN 'II' THEN 50 WHEN 'III' THEN 75 WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
               ELSE 50
             END
           ) AS cwas
  FROM (
    SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm, c.homezip, c.soccd, c.headct, c.statustag,
           CAST(c.visacls AS VARCHAR) AS visa_class,
           strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS begin_date,
           date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))::DATE AS start_month,
           cw.wsstate,
           e.employer_contact_info->>'$.naics_code' AS naics_code,
           pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.level' AS wage_level,
           CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.from', '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
             * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.offered_wage.unit'
                 WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
               END AS aow,
           CAST(replace(replace(pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.value', 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)
             * CASE pw.wage_details->>'$.prevailing_wage.unit'
                 WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080 WHEN 'Week' THEN 52 WHEN 'Month' THEN 12 WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
               END AS apw
    FROM main.cases c
    JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
```

```sql
WITH return_rows AS (
    SELECT
        o.buyerlink,
        substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS return_month,
        r.return_channel,
        c.seg_category,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        r.return_details -> 'reasoning' ->> 'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        qa.assessment_summary -> 'condition' ->> 'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
        ) AS cmrc
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
),
charges AS (
    SELECT
        rr.*,
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT rule.flat_charge + rule.charge_pct / 100.0 * rr.unit_value
                FROM return_charge_rules rule
                WHERE (rule.customer_segment IS NULL OR rule.customer_segment = rr.seg_category)
                  AND (rule.return_channel IS NULL OR rule.return_channel = rr.return_channel)
                  AND (rule.item_category IS NULL OR rule.item_category = rr.itemcategory)
                  AND (rule.primary_reason IS NULL OR rule.primary_reason = rr.primary_reason)
                  AND (rule.item_condition IS NULL OR rule.item_condition = rr.item_condition)
                  AND (rule.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rule.min_monthly_returns <= rr.cmrc)
                  AND (rule.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rule.max_monthly_returns >= rr.cmrc)
                ORDER BY rule.rule_id
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            15.00 + 5.0 / 100.0 * rr.unit_value
        ) AS rhc
    FROM return_rows rr
)

FROM charges
WHERE buyerlink = 'CUS00032'
```

```sql
      AND r.revdate < '2025-03-01'
),
eligible_rules AS (
    SELECT
        t.casenum,
        t.unit_value,
        rc.rule_id,
        rc.flat_charge,
        rc.charge_pct,

        CASE
            WHEN rc.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
             AND rc.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
            THEN rc.max_monthly_returns - rc.min_monthly_returns

),
```

```sql
            PARTITION BY c.profilenum, date_trunc('month', try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE))
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns AS r
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products AS p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment AS q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE c.profilenum = 'CUS00104'
      AND try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND try_cast(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        b.casenum,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        b.unit_value,
        (
            CASE WHEN rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = 'ANY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = 'ANY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = 'ANY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = 'ANY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = 'ANY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        ) AS categorical_specificity,
        (
            CASE WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        ) AS range_specificity
    FROM base AS b
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules AS rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = 'ANY' OR rr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = 'ANY' OR rr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = 'ANY' OR rr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = 'ANY' OR rr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = 'ANY' OR rr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns >= rr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.monthly_returns <= rr.max_monthly_returns)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY categorical_specificity DESC,
                     range_specificity DESC,
                     rule_id ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
    FROM matches
)
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(COALESCE(flat_charge + unit_value * charge_pct / 100.0, 0)),
    2
) AS total_rhc
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
```

```sql
WITH customer_month_counts AS (
    SELECT
```
```sql
        o.buyerlink,
```
```sql
        date_trunc('month', TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE)) AS return_month,
```
```sql
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_returns

    WHERE TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'

    GROUP BY

            * TRY_CAST(f.cost_breakdown->'valuation'->>'value_loss_pct' AS DOUBLE)
            / 100.0 AS leakage
    FROM returns r

    WHERE TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'

)
SELECT ROUND(
```

```sql
WITH target AS (

        pr.snapkey,
        pm.makertag,
        pm.pnlkind,
        a.alrtstate,
        p.warrstate,
        CASE
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS cap_band,
        o.replcost
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pm.makertag = 'Canadian Solar'
      AND pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'
      AND pr.snapts <  TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01'
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN 'Single'
            WHEN COUNT(*) <= 5 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Bulk'
        END AS vol_tier
    FROM target
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        t.snapkey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.fixed_fee_usd + r.cover_pct * t.replcost / 100.0 AS settlement,
        (CASE WHEN r.maker_tag <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM target t
    CROSS JOIN monthly_volume mv
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
      ON (r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)

     AND (r.vol_tier = 'ALL' OR r.vol_tier = mv.vol_tier)
),
ranked AS (

        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY snapkey
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM candidates
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(settlement), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
```

answer:
Canadian Solar’s July 2019 warranty settlement was **$6,712.90 USD**.

```sql
WITH all_snapshots AS (
  SELECT pr.snapkey, pr.snapts,
         COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
         pm.makertag, pm.pnlkind,
         a.alrtstate, p.warrstate,
         CASE WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
              WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
              WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large' END AS cap_band,
         COALESCE(om.replcost, 0) AS replcost,
         COUNT(*) OVER (
           PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', pr.snapts),
                        COALESCE(pm.makertag, 'Unlisted')
         ) AS monthly_volume
  FROM plant_record pr
  LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  LEFT JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = pr.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN operational_metrics om ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
),
target AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
              WHEN monthly_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
              ELSE 'Bulk' END AS vol_tier
  FROM all_snapshots
  WHERE snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'
    AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01'
    AND maker_group = 'Canadian Solar'
),
matches AS (
  SELECT s.snapkey, r.rule_id, r.fixed_fee_usd, r.cover_pct,
         ((r.maker_tag IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
          (r.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
          (r.alrt_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
          (r.warr_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
          (r.cap_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER +
          (r.vol_tier IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER) AS specificity
  FROM target s
  JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
    ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
   AND (r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)
   AND (r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = s.alrtstate)
   AND (r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = s.warrstate)
   AND (r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = s.cap_band)
   AND (r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = s.vol_tier)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY snapkey
           ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM matches
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT s.snapkey, s.replcost,
         COALESCE(r.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS fixed_fee_usd,
         COALESCE(r.cover_pct, 5.00) AS cover_pct
  FROM target s
  LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.snapkey = s.snapkey AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(fixed_fee_usd + cover_pct / 100.0 * replcost), 2) AS settlement_usd
FROM resolved;
```

```sql
    SUM(rvl) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_value), 0) AS clr
  FROM per_return
  GROUP BY customer, return_month
),

      WHEN clr < 0.55 THEN 'Contained'
      WHEN clr < 0.70 THEN 'Elevated'
      ELSE 'Severe'
    END AS leakage_class
  FROM customer_month
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN mc.leakage_class = 'Severe' THEN pr.rvl ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(SUM(pr.rvl), 0),
  2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM per_return pr
JOIN monthly_class mc
  ON mc.customer = pr.customer
 AND mc.return_month = pr.return_month;
```

```sql
      + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

          + CASE WHEN r.pnl_kind IS NULL OR r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state IS NULL OR r.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN r.warr_state IS NULL OR r.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN r.cap_band IS NULL OR r.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
          + CASE WHEN r.vol_tier IS NULL OR r.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        ) DESC,

    ) AS rn
  FROM snapshot_values s
  JOIN warranty_settle_rules r
    ON (r.maker_tag IS NULL OR r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
```

```sql
          + CASE WHEN r.alrt_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.warr_state <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.cap_band <> 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
```
```sql
        ) AS specificity,
        r.rule_id
    FROM snapshot_data AS s
    JOIN warranty_settle_rules AS r
      ON r.vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
     AND (r.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR r.maker_tag = s.makertag)
     AND (r.pnl_kind = 'ALL' OR r.pnl_kind = s.pnlkind)

    FROM matches
)
```

```sql
         m.pnlkind,
         a.alrtstate,
         p.warrstate,
         CASE WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
              WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
              WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
         END AS cap_band,
         o.replcost
  FROM plant_record r

  LEFT JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
  LEFT JOIN alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
  LEFT JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey

         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY maker_group, claim_month) AS claim_volume
  FROM snapshot_base
),
eligible AS (

         s.replcost,
         w.rule_id,
         w.cover_pct,
         (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

        + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
        + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS specificity
  FROM snapshots s
  LEFT JOIN warranty_settle_rules w
```

```sql
  SELECT
```

```sql
    s.replcost,
    w.rule_id,
    w.fixed_fee_usd,
    w.cover_pct,
    (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
     + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
     + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
     + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
     + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
     + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = 'ALL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS spec
  FROM snapshot_tiers s
```
```sql
  LEFT JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
    ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = 'ALL' OR w.maker_tag = s.makertag)

    replcost,
```

```sql
WITH ep AS (
```

```sql
FROM plant_record r

  AND r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-05-01 00:00:00'
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_values AS (
    SELECT
        pm.pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS month_start,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,

    FROM plant_record AS pr

    JOIN electrical_performance AS ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey

        month_start,
        energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS e_pot,

        100.0 * e_loss / total_e_pot AS loss_ratio
    FROM monthly_totals
)

        WHEN loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'

        WHEN loss_ratio < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
```

answer:
The schema does not define an Energy Loss Band, so I treated bands as quartiles of the technology-month average recoverable loss, where recoverable loss is energy yield multiplied by soil-loss percentage. Under that interpretation:

| loss_band | snapshots | avg_loss_kwh |
|---|---:|---:|
| Low | 23 | 28.50 |
| Severe | 25 | 138.22 |

```sql
WITH snapshot_loss AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pm.pnlkind AS technology,
        date_trunc('month', pr.snapts)::DATE AS month_start,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(
            ep.elec_perf_snapshot,
            '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh'
        ) AS DOUBLE)
        * TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(
            ep.elec_perf_snapshot,
            '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct'
        ) AS DOUBLE) / 100.0 AS recoverable_loss_kwh
    FROM plant_record AS pr
    JOIN plants AS p
        ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS pm
        ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance AS ep
        ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
technology_month AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        month_start,
        AVG(recoverable_loss_kwh) AS avg_loss_kwh
    FROM snapshot_loss
    GROUP BY technology, month_start
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        month_start,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_loss_kwh) AS loss_quartile
    FROM technology_month
),
tagged AS (
    SELECT
        technology,
        month_start,
        CASE loss_quartile
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM ranked
    WHERE loss_quartile IN (1, 4)
)
SELECT
    t.loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(s.recoverable_loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM snapshot_loss AS s
JOIN tagged AS t
    ON t.technology = s.technology
   AND t.month_start = s.month_start
GROUP BY t.loss_band
ORDER BY CASE t.loss_band WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Severe' THEN 2 END;
```

```sql
  FROM snapshot_yields
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_values AS (
```
